label: Qrcode
depicts: Stylized QR code block with one tall left finder box and one smaller lower right finder box
use_when: Use when the interface wants a more stylized or simplified QR code pattern with larger open gaps.
avoid_when: Do not use for the classic QR code when all three standard corner finder boxes should be clear and balanced.

label: Help
depicts: Question mark centered inside one circular ring with one small dot below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a help or question cue enclosed by a circular border.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain question mark when the mark should stand alone with no outer ring.

label: Help
depicts: Standalone question mark with one small dot below and no surrounding ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bare question mark cue without any outer border.
avoid_when: Do not use for the circled help icon when the question mark should sit inside a full round frame.

label: Radar
depicts: Round radar target made from concentric arcs with one diagonal sweep line crossing the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic circular radar target with ring marks and a sweep line.
avoid_when: Do not use for the angled radar dish when the shape should lean in one direction instead of staying round.

label: Radar
depicts: Angled radar dish with signal arcs fanning toward the upper right from one slanted base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a directional radar dish or scanner that points outward in one angled direction.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round radar target when the icon should stay centered with concentric rings.
